The '''Umaren'k'sa''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umaren'k]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. After another species, the [[Hemes Arbora]], migrated to their world, the Umaren'k'sa adopted much of their visitors' culture, a societal shift that was prompted by the appearance of the sentient planet [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] in the [[Umaren'k system/Legends|Umaren'k system]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Umaren'k'sa were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings.<ref name="CSWE III 279" />

==Society and culture==
The species hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umaren'k]]<ref name="CSWE III 279" /> in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The Umaren'k'sa adopted many elements of culture from another sentient species, the [[Hemes Arbora]].<ref name="CSWE III 279" />

==History==
At some point in the Umaren'k'sa's history, the Hemes Arbora&mdash;a species from [[Carrivar|another world]]&mdash;immigrated to Umaren'k. Shortly thereafter, the sentient planet [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] moved into the [[Umaren'k system/Legends|Umaren'k system]], and the strange appearance caused the Umaren'k'sa to adopt many aspects of Hemes Arbora culture.<ref name="CSWE III 279" /> The Hemes Arbora eventually moved on to the planet [[Osseriton/Legends|Osseriton]]. Another Unknown Regions species, the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], knew of the Umaren'k'sa and had records of them in their [[Expeditionary Library]] on the planet [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]].<ref name="FHII 3" />

In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] discovered references to Umaren'k'sa history while looking for information on Zonama Sekot in the Expeditionary [[Library/Legends|Library]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] surmised that Umaren'k'sa culture had been influenced by the Hemes Arbora after the planet's arrival in their [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="FHII 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Umaren'k'sa are mentioned briefly in the novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]'', written by [[Sean Williams]] and [[Shane Dix]] and published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2003]]. In the novel, the Jedi Knight Saba Sebatyne theorizes about Umaren'k'sa culture; however, the book does not definitively state that the Umaren'k'sa are a unique species. ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]], includes an entry on the Umaren'k'sa that explicitly labels them a species and confirms Saba Sebatyne's suppositions about them.<ref name="CSWE III 279" />
